**Last Updated: August 5th 2026**

### Summary 
This dataset repository contains de-identified fMRI and T1-weighted imaging data acquired from 10  Parkinson's disease patients (aged 50-76 years) receiving deep brain stimulation therapy. All patients were implanted in either the Subthalamic Nucleus or the Globus Pallidus Internus.

### Data Acquisition
For details on data acquisition, please refer to the accompanying BOLD JSON sidecar files.

### BOLD Metadata

Separate BOLD JSON sidecar files are provided for the 36- and 38-slice acquisitions.

| Subject(s) | Slices |
|------------|----------------:|
| `sub-01` (`ses-01`), `sub-01` (`ses-02`), `sub-09` (`ses-02`), `sub-16` (`ses-01`) | 36 |
| All remaining BOLD acquisitions | 38 |

### Study Details
For information on our test-retest study and subsequent findings, please refer to our manuscript: 
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.nicl.2026.103973
